precision: Two archives carry overlapping measurements of `missing`. They overlap on some quantities and DIVERGE on one that shares a name. Derived by recomputation on the same two images (1050x536 = 562800 px). SAME QUANTITY, rounding only: inkOv 50.84 here vs 50.8 in the ink archive (1 decimal); rowCorr 0.6100 vs 0.610 (3 decimals); colCorr 0.4423 vs 0.442 (3 decimals). DIFFERENT QUANTITY, SAME NAME: this file flat_bg_pct_of_canvas = 34.92 = 100*(pixels outside the ink-union mask)/(H*W) = 196546/562800, quote it as "ink-complement share"; the ink archive flatBgPct = 37.13 = 100*max(modal-colour pixel count over the two images)/(H*W) = 208980/562800, quote it as "modal-colour coverage". Gap 2.21pp; they coincide only when the modal colour happens to equal the ink complement, which is not the case here. Both are correct for their own definition. AUTHORITY: this directory is authoritative for the per-digit decomposition; the content-mask-overlap archive is authoritative for the 16-scene comparison and the verdict rule. No value was changed to make the two agree. See precision_correction for what an earlier version of this field wrongly claimed.
